# Tactical Memory

A compact, high-signal store of hard-won facts about this specific codebase.

## Retain

- Invocation patterns and flags verified to work in this stack.
- Rules that were discovered through breakage and must not regress.
- Observed tool behavior that affects output correctness (host order, quoting, sequencing).

## Discard

- Generic documentation with no direct relevance to this repository.
- Redundant entries already visible in version history or inline comments.
- Prose summaries that merely echo the original task description.

## Mutation Rule

New evidence that contradicts an existing entry replaces it entirely. Never append conflicting guidance alongside the old entry.

## Quality Bar

Outcomes are demonstrated through the project's own verification mechanisms. Changes stay proportional to what the task actually requires.
